method.evidenceLevel: public GitHub path and index metadata only
method.statement: Paths and manifest filenames identify research surfaces only; they do not prove implementation, behavior, quality, security, rights or Dora fit.

components.name: Mobile capture and lifecycle surface
components.rationale: Path and manifest names identify a potentially relevant surface, but Phase A did not retrieve source, manifest contents, tests or license bytes. Reuse, port and behavior claims are prohibited.
components.fallback: Retain Dora-owned capture and lifecycle contracts behind replaceable ports.

components.name: Backend STT, VAD, diarization and provider surface
components.rationale: Names alone cannot establish algorithms, dependencies, operational behavior, license compatibility or failure handling.
components.fallback: Keep cloud optional and disabled; preserve Dora provider ports and local-mode contracts.

components.name: Storage, synchronization and deletion metadata surface

observedPathMetadata.keywordMatchedPathCountNote: Counts are path-keyword observations in upstream-snapshot tree metadata, not behavior evidence.

components.rationale: No schema, migration, job, deletion, sync or state-transition content was retrieved. Compatibility with Dora authoritative-user-truth rules is unknown.
components.fallback: Use Dora-owned storage, reconciliation and deletion specifications until a separately authorized source audit proves a safer portable boundary.
components.futureOwnerRole: unassigned Storage Engineering and Security/Privacy reviewers

components.name: Contracts and contract-test surface
components.rationale: The paths are credible metadata leads for a later read-only audit; no contract or test content was inspected and nothing is imported.
components.fallback: Continue using Dora-owned versioned contracts and deterministic synthetic fixtures.

components.name: Device protocol SDK surface
components.rationale: A Dora device port is not in the active stage. Source and protocol content were not retrieved.
components.fallback: No SDK or device dependency; retain a future replaceable protocol port.
components.futureOwnerRole: unassigned Device Engineering and Security reviewers

components.name: Omi firmware and hardware surface
components.rationale: Firmware and hardware are outside current Dora MVP 1 implementation scope; nested rights and vendored-code provenance are unresolved.
components.fallback: No hardware promise or firmware dependency.
components.futureOwnerRole: unassigned Firmware Engineering, Product/Legal/IP and Security reviewers

components.name: Repository tests, failure classes and security-document paths
components.rationale: Path metadata suggests future audit value. Phase A did not retrieve test, workflow or security-document contents.
components.fallback: Use Dora Test Strategy and existing deterministic gates.

components.name: Desktop applications
doraRelevance: possible lifecycle and local-processing lessons only
components.rationale: Desktop product behavior is outside Dora Android MVP 1 and no concrete current contract requires deep review.

components.name: Web and infrastructure surfaces
doraRelevance: possible future optional cloud operations only
components.rationale: Cloud and web remain optional, separately consented and outside the active stage.
components.fallback: Local mode remains functional without account, network, GMS or cloud configuration.
components.futureOwnerRole: unassigned Backend, Security/Privacy and Product/Legal reviewers

components.name: Plugins and MCP integrations
doraRelevance: none for current MVP core; possible future integrations
components.rationale: Marketplace, plugin and MCP integration surfaces are outside current scope and introduce additional service and rights boundaries.
components.fallback: No plugin, MCP or external-service dependency.

components.name: OmiGlass product, firmware and vendored dependency surface
components.rationale: A separate product/hardware surface with vendored dependencies is outside current Dora scope; rights and provenance are unresolved.
components.fallback: No OmiGlass dependency, firmware, asset or hardware claim.
components.futureOwnerRole: unassigned Firmware Engineering, Product/Legal/IP and Security reviewers

components.name: License, manifest and vendored-artifact surface
components.rationale: Only Git tree path metadata and GitHub licenseInfo were collected. Exact terms, dependencies, notices, binaries and embedded assets were not inspected.
components.fallback: Do not retrieve, execute, copy, port or admit any Omi artifact.
components.futureOwnerRole: named Product/Legal/IP and Engineering/Security reviewers required

nextGate: Any source-level assessment requires separate exact-scope retrieval authority, exact rights disposition, and named reviewers. This matrix creates no PoC or implementation task.
noAdmissionStatement: No Omi source, dependency, binary, model, dataset, asset, service, schema, test or behavior is evaluated or admitted.
